title: 3 Everyday Habits Damaging Your Pipes
description: Small daily habits can lead to big plumbing issues over time. One common mistake is relying on chemical drain cleaners. These harsh products can corrode older pipes and rarely solve the root cause of a blockage. Another frequent issue is flushing wipes labeled as flushable, which do not break down like toilet paper and often cause stubborn line clogs. Finally, over-tightening plumbing fixtures during minor DIY fixes can strip threads and create hidden leaks. To keep your system running smoothly, stick to basic maintenance drain strainers and consult a licensed plumber when drains slow down.
